author: Top Gear
description:
This is the world’s most expensive Range Rover. Built by long-time Land Rover customisers Overfinch, it’s a collab with shooting connoisseurs Holland & Holland, and a homage to the latter's flagship shotgun, the ‘Royal’. Prices start at around £450k, before options – and options include a matching pair of shotguns!

🚗 Overfinch ‘Holland & Holland Edition’ Range Rover SV
🎤 Tom Ford
